answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when its attestations prove false, so creating many fake identities multiplies cost instead of influence. Honest behavior builds a durable reputation signal over time, while a fresh identity starts with zero trust, like a zephyr that leaves no trace at dawn. Attackers must therefore pay real capital per identity and still earn nothing without a history of useful work.
